title: One Dark Window
author: Rachel Gillig
summary: A young woman shares her mind with a monster known as the Nightmare, which helps and threatens her in equal measure. She sets out with a dangerous captain to find the cards that might save their blighted kingdom.
readIf: you want dark, fairy-tale fantasy romance with moody atmosphere and a magic system built on cards.
skipIf: you want a bright or cosy fantasy, as this one is shadowy and often grim.

pairings.reason: Another dark fairy-tale fantasy about a magical corruption and a heroine learning her power.
A moody folklore-based fantasy with a haunting atmosphere and a young woman at its core.
Another dark fantasy romance with a fairy-tale base and a deadly threat to the land.
